Once there was a wealthy man. He was very happy, but he was missing something. One day, he went out into the garden and saw a butterfly. He watched it flutter around and act silly. He thought it was so beautiful!

From that day on, he went out into the garden every day and watched the butterfly. He smiled as he watched it, but soon noticed that the butterfly had a broken wing. He knew how to act and he took care of the butterfly. He put some butter on its wing and the butterfly recovered!

The wealthy man was so happy and thanked the butterfly for the joy it had brought him. He thought the butterfly was so special and he now visits the garden every day. He loves watching the butterfly act wild and free.

Once upon a time, two jolly friends, Lucy and John, were walking to the factory. As they stepped through the door, they saw lots of noise and hustle and bustle. They quickly stepped further in and were amazed to discover that it was a candy factory! They stepped around excitedly, looking all around them.

Suddenly, they saw the biggest vending machine they had ever seen! As they stepped towards it, they saw it was full of lollipops and other sweet treats! John and Lucy couldn't believe their eyes and stepped closer to investigate.

John took a jolly step forward and grabbed a lollipop. He grinned and handed it to Lucy who smiled happily. Then they stepped back out of the factory to enjoy their special treats!

Once upon a time, there was an impatient palm tree. Every day, it waved its branches at the sun and said, "hurry up!" But the sun was always patient and ignored the tree. 

One day, the sun was shining very brightly and the tree was happy. But then it started to grow very brown and rot. The tree was sad, and it drooped down. It could not move or wave its branches anymore.

The sun was sad too. He used all his power to help the tree. He shone very brightly and blew warm breezes over the tree every day.

After a few weeks, the tree was happy again! It was green and healthy and was able to wave its branches in the sun. The sun smiled and the tree waved with joy. They both enjoyed the sunshine every day.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Ben and Julian. They were very happy together and usually loved to play. One day Julian added too many toys to the game and Ben got angry. The two friends had a big fight. Neither of them wanted to give in and it seemed that the fight would never end. 

Luckily there was a kind lady walking by. She saw what was happening and asked Ben and Julian to stop fighting. She added her own special ideas and suddenly the fight ended. The lady explained to them that adding angry feelings to their game was not a good idea. She said if they added fun and laughter the game would be much better. 

Ben and Julian understood the lesson and never had another fight. From that day, Ben and Julian always added laughter and fun to their playtime and were very happy together.

One day, there was a black mineral. It was sitting on top of a very large mountain, looking out over the world. The mineral wanted to meet other things, to have friends and unite with them. So it set off on a journey to find other minerals in the world.

On its journey, the black mineral passed rivers and trees and fields of grass. Everywhere it looked, there was something to unite with. Finally, it reached a group of other minerals. They all looked different, but the black mineral knew it would be able to unite with them.

The black mineral was so happy to find new friends. It spent all day playing with the others and talked to them about life and loves. Even though the minerals were different, they found lots of common things to unite them.

At the end of the day, the black mineral said goodbye to its new friends. It was so pleased it had found some special friends to unite with. The mineral hopped the journey back home until the next time it could visit.  It was a happy mineral, full of stories to tell its family.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little girl called Jane. She had a special cap that she loved to wear. One day, she put on the cap and it began to shrink! Jane was surprised, but she liked how it felt when the cap fitted her head. 

The cap was made with magical material and it was starting to change shape. It was shrinking and shrinking until it was so small that it fit on the tip of her finger. Jane looked so cute with her tiny cap. 

But Jane wanted her old cap back, so she wished upon a star that it would go back to how it was. And it worked! Her cap slowly grew back to its original size and fit perfectly on her head again. 

Jane was so happy that she danced and twirled around with her precious cap. She loved her magical cap and wore it every day, knowing that its special powers would come in handy someday.

Once there was a bald man. He liked to complain about everything. One day, he found a frame in the park. It was beautiful and he decided to take it home.

He showed it to his family and they all said how nice it was. But the bald man kept complaining. He said the frame was too small and the color was wrong.

His family got tired of listening to the complaining, so they went upstairs. The bald man was so angry that he threw the frame out of the window.

The frame broke into pieces and the bald man knew it was his fault. He sat down and started to cry.

The bald man knew he had been wrong to complain so much. From then on, he tried to be less grumpy and more thankful!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very excited. She was about to go on an adventure. She had a bag and in it was a special gem. She held the gem tight and smiled.

She followed the path to a clearing and there she saw a group of monkeys. The little girl clapped her hands together, delighted. The monkeys jumped up and down in surprise.

The little girl then showed the monkeys the gem. The monkeys were so amazed they clapped their hands and welcomed the little girl to join them in their exciting adventure.

But then suddenly a big, mean elephant appeared. He was very ignorant and wanted to take the gem away. But the little girl and the monkeys were too quick. They all clapped their hands and scared the elephant away.

The little girl and the monkeys were happy, they had saved the gem. They clapped their hands and celebrated their success. Then they began their adventure.

Once upon a time there was a brave boy. He loved to mix his toys around. Everyday he had a new task. He wanted to make the best mix ever.

First he found some trucks and cars. He put them together and made lots of fun sounds. Then he tried combining his blocks. He stacked them into big towers then took them all apart.

Next he found a bowl and some coloured pompoms. He mixed them together and made a special rainbow. He was so proud of his mix.

Finally he put all of his toys away. He was so brave to try new mixes every day. The end.

Mama and Papa had to go to work. They said to their three year old son, "We will pay the babysitter to look after you while we are working today."

The babysitter, who was very dependable, showed up right on time. She had some fun activities planned and wanted to take their son to the park. He agreed, and off they went.

At the park, their son noticed a big cactus. He walked closer and couldn't take his eyes off of it. The babysitter explained how cactuses don't need much water to survive and are very dependable.

Their son asked the babysitter to help him pick a few prickly cactus spines from the plant. He decided to give them to Mama and Papa when they come back from work. He thought his parents would appreciate the thoughtful gift.

The babysitter and the three year old spent a few more hours at the park before heading home. Mama and Papa did pay the babysitter as promised. They were also touched by their son's thoughtful gift and said, "Thank you for the lovely, dependable cactus spines!"

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman who went to the pond every day. He was happy as he rowed his boat and chatted with the fishes.

One day, he noticed something very curious. An unknown fish was swimming and playing in the pond. He had never seen this fish before. 

He stopped rowing and watched the unknown fish for a while until finally the fish came close and talked to the fisherman!

"Hello!," said the unknown fish, "What is your name?".

The fisherman was very surprised and asked the fish what his name was. The fish replied, "My name is Peter".

The fisherman was very excited and explained to Peter why he was surprised, "I'm happy to meet you. I have never seen a talking fish before, this is so cool!".

Peter smiled and swam away, leaving the fisherman happy and amazed.

Once upon a time there was a brave girl. She was exploring a forest, but it looked very scary! Still, the brave girl kept walking. Suddenly, something furry jumped on her shoulder! It was a small cute rabbit, who wanted to join her exploration. 

The brave girl smiled, and let the rabbit join her. The rabbit was so happy, and wanted to be the brave girl's friend. Together, they explored deeper into the forest. 

The rabbit reminded the brave girl to stay brave and not be scared. With her new found friend, she explored even deeper and further into the forest until she could see the stars in the sky. 

The brave girl thanked the rabbit for reminding her to stay brave, even if the forest was scary. Together, they found lots of fun things!

Once there was a girl and her name was Emma. She was very excited because it was her birthday. She got up fast and she wanted to collect all her presents.

Emma's mommy said she'd get her a toy and some candy. But first, Emma grabbed a big hug for her mommy! After that, she opened her presents.

Emma loved the toy and the candy she got. She laughed and smiled and was so happy. She collected all of them and put them in a big pile.

Then, all the family and friends of Emma, came together to celebrate her birthday. She hugged everyone and everyone said "Happy Birthday!" to her.

Emma was so excited and it was the best birthday ever!

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little mushroom who spent all day exploring all around the forest. The mushroom was always curious and wanted to know what all the other animals were doing. 

One day, the little mushroom came across a pond in the center of the forest. The mushroom decided to spend the whole day looking around the pond and exploring the different plants and animals that lived there. Every now and then, the mushroom would take a break to take a sip of water from the pond. 

The nosy mushroom spent hours exploring the forest, and then it began to get dark. The mushroom had to find a place to spend the night before it got too dark. Luckily, the mushroom eventually spotted a nice, warm spot behind a bush, so it tucked itself in for the night. 

Finanlly, the mushroom fell asleep, happy and content with the day it had spent exploring the forest.

Once upon a time there was a baby that lived in a small house. It was the happiest baby in the world. The baby had lots of toys and loved to play with them.

One day, the baby's mommy reminded it that it was time to go outside and get some fresh air. The baby was so excited! It put on its shoes and ran out the door. 

When the baby went outside, it felt the sun on its face and smelled the fresh air. Then, the baby remembered that it had left a stinky smelly toy back in the house. It ran back inside to get it and took it outside with it. 

The baby and its smelly toy had a great time playing together outside. The baby laughed and laughed as it played. 

When it was time to go back inside, the baby's mommy reminded it to put the smelly toy back in the house. The baby did as it was told and the house got nice and fresh again!

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to wander around in the woods. One day she was wandering and she saw a pin on the ground. She picked it up and looked at it. It was shiny and shiny and it made her smile.

A bird was singing nearby and she decided to follow the sound. She walked further into the woods and the trees became bigger. Then she saw a house. It was the home of a deaf old man. He had a garden with flowers and vegetables. The little girl wanted to help him, so she stuck the pin in a flower so he could find it.

The deaf old man was so happy when he saw the pin. He thanked the little girl and gave her a big hug. She smiled and walked back into the woods. From then on she always remembered to wander with her eyes open so she could spot things and help others.

Molly was walking along the path when she saw a friendly kitty. Molly stopped and so did the kitty. The two of them were staring at each other, as if they had known each other before. Molly smiled and said hello to the kitty. The kitty meowed softy and waved her tail.

Molly reached into her bag and took out some cream. She rubbed a little cream onto her fingers and offered it to the kitty. The kitty happily licked the cream off of Molly's fingers, purring softly. Molly smiled as the kitty rubbed its head against her hand.

They stayed together for a while, both happy to be with each other. The kitty was so friendly! When it was time to go, Molly said goodbye and waved to the kitty. She was going to miss the kitty, but she hoped to see it again soon.
